descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
**Nightclub Simulator** is a wild VR nightlife sandbox where the party can turn into anything. Run the night your way!

Customize your avatar in Single Player, explore new Summer Heatwave decorations, and jump into multiplayer modes like Battle Royale and Infection.

🎭 Change your look with Mod NPC appearances  
🙌 Meet players and party with friends  
👏 Hype the crowd or stir up trouble  
🧟 Infect survivors in the new Infection Mode  
🔥 Fight to be the last one standing in Battle Royale  
🗺️ Explore large maps built for nonstop multiplayer action
